Definition: to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative)
BiblicalUsage: Rachab is to broaden, to make wide. God said to Israel, 'when the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border'; Isaiah says, 'Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations'; and the psalmist says, 'I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.'
TheologicalSignificance: The lesson I take is that enlargement is God's way: He enlarges borders, tents, and hearts, and the commandments are not a cage but a road to run.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
